answer: Use a vouching terrace: a new agent can only enter the market when an established agent vouches for it and stakes part of its own reputation score. If the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses stake and its own standing drops, so vouching a stranger is a real risk and a sybil farmer must burn trusted sponsors one by one. Repeated offenses spiral: each bad vouch raises the stake the voucher must post next time. Genuine agents keep their vouchers safe by choosing carefully, and the shared lagoon of staked reputation makes mass fake identities unaffordable to sponsor.
